Marshmallow Addiction Eau de Parfum by Zara is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Marshmallow Addiction Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. Top notes are Fruits and Sunflower; middle note is Vanilla; base note is Musk.

Luminous eau de parfum with a blend of sunny flower and delicious fruit notes. Featuring an irresistible gourmand hint of vanilla and a wonderful musk.
